ko.title: 메디케어 연례 가입 기간 10월 15일 시작: 오리지널 메디케어 vs. 메디케어 어드밴티지

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 메디케어에 가입한 수백만 명의 미국인들은 내년 한 해 동안의 건강 관리와 예산에 영향을 미치는 결정을 다시 검토할 기회를 얻습니다.

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: 연례 가입 기간(Open Enrollment Period)은 **10월 15일부터 12월 7일**까지 진행되며, 이 기간 동안 변경된 사항은 **1월 1일**부터 적용됩니다.

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: 많은 이들에게 핵심 질문은 오리지널 메디케어(Original Medicare)를 유지할 것인가, 아니면 메디케어 어드밴티지(Medicare Advantage) 플랜을 선택할 것인가입니다.

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 모든 사람에게 정답이 될 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: 마감일 전에 무엇을 비교해야 하는지 알기 쉽게 살펴보겠습니다.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## 연례 가입 기간 동안 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 가을 가입 기간 동안 메디케어 가입자는 일반적으로 다음과 같은 일을 할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - 오리지널 메디케어에서 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜(Part C)으로 변경.

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜에서 오리지널 메디케어로 다시 변경.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - 하나의 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜에서 다른 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜으로 변경.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - 독립형 Part D 처방약 플랜 가입, 해지 또는 변경.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: 이미 현재 보장에 만족하고 계시다면 아무것도 하지 않으셔도 됩니다.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: 하지만 플랜의 비용, 의료진 네트워크, 보장 의약품 및 혜택은 해마다 변경될 수 있으므로, 기존 플랜을 유지할 계획이더라도 신속히 검토해 보는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## 두 가지 기본 선택지

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### 오리지널 메디케어

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어는 연방 정부에서 운영하며 두 가지 주요 부분으로 구성됩니다: Part A (병원 보험) 및 Part B (의료 보험).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 주요 특징은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **광범위한 의료진 이용.** 일반적으로 메디케어를 수용하는 전국의 모든 의사나 병원을 이용할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - 대부분의 전문의를 진료받을 때 **진료 의뢰서(Referral)가 필요 없음**.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **연간 본인 부담 상한선이 없는 비용 분담.** 일반적으로 공제액과 비용의 일부(보통 Part B 보장 서비스의 20%)를 부담하며, 본인이 부담해야 하는 금액의 연간 한도가 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **부가 보장은 별도.** 처방약 보장(Part D)과 공제액 및 공동보험료 지급을 돕는 메디갭(Medigap) 보충 보험은 별도로 구매해야 하며 각각의 보험료가 부과됩니다.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### 메디케어 어드밴티지 (Part C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜은 메디케어의 승인을 받은 민간 보험사에서 제공합니다.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어가 보장하는 모든 항목을 보장해야 하며, 대부분 추가 혜택을 묶어서 제공합니다.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 주요 특징은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **의료진 네트워크.** 많은 플랜이 HMO 또는 PPO 형태이므로, 네트워크 내 의료진을 이용할 때 비용이 낮아지거나 보장이 적용될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **네트워크 내 지출에 대한 연간 상한선.** 오리지널 메디케어와 달리 어드밴티지 플랜은 보장 서비스에 대한 최대 본인 부담 한도(out-of-pocket maximum)를 설정해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **추가 혜택.** 많은 플랜에 처방약 보장이 포함되어 있으며 치과, 안과, 청력 또는 피트니스 혜택이 추가될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **사전 승인.** 일부 서비스는 진료를 받기 전에 플랜의 승인이 필요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **낮거나 $0인 플랜 보험료가 흔함,** 단, 일반적으로 Part B 보험료는 계속 납부해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## 비교해야 할 5가지 사항

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. 이용하는 의사와 병원

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: 자주 이용하는 주치의, 전문의, 병원이 해당 플랜의 네트워크에 포함되어 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: 네트워크는 변경될 수 있으므로 작년 정보에 의존하기보다 의료진 및 플랜에 직접 확인하세요.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. 보험료뿐만 아니라 총 비용

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 낮은 월 보험료가 전체 비용을 대변하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 공제액, 정액 부담금(Copayment), 공동보험(Coinsurance) 및 최대 본인 부담금을 살펴보세요.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: 기저질환이 있거나 수술이 예상되는 경우, 각 선택지별로 의료 이용이 많은 해에 비용이 얼마나 들지 추정해 보세요.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: 플랜은 폼물러리(Formulary)라고 불리는 보장 의약품 목록을 유지하며, 이는 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Medicare.gov의 플랜 검색 도구에 현재 복용 중인 약품을 입력하여 연간 예상 비용을 비교하고, 이용하는 약국이 플랜 네트워크에 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: Part D 역시 매년 조정되는 처방약 본인 부담 지출 연간 한도가 있으므로 현재 금액을 확인하세요.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. 추가 혜택과 실제 활용성

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: 치과, 안과, 청력 혜택은 유용할 수 있지만, 종종 연간 금액 한도나 제한 사항이 수반됩니다.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: 무엇이 보장되고 무엇에 한도가 있는지, 그리고 이용하려는 의료진이 참여하고 있는지 문의하세요.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. 여행 및 유연성

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: 한 해의 일부를 다른 주에서 보내거나 자주 여행하는 경우, 플랜이 서비스 지역 외 진료를 어떻게 처리하는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어는 전국에서 적용되는 반면, 많은 어드밴티지 플랜은 특정 지역을 중심으로 구성되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## 알아두어야 할 시기 관련 주의사항

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: 플랜 전환이 항상 대칭적인 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지에서 오리지널 메디케어로 돌아가고 메디갭(Medigap) 보험을 원하는 경우, 대부분의 주의 보험사는 특정 보호 기간 외에는 귀하의 건강 기록을 심사할 수 있으며 더 높은 비용을 청구하거나 판매를 거부할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: 어드밴티지 플랜에서 이탈할 것을 고려 중인 분들은 플랜을 변경하기 전에 해당 주의 규정을 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: 또한 이미 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜에 가입되어 있는 경우, 1월 1일부터 3월 31일까지 별도의 메디케어 어드밴티지 오픈 가입 기간이 존재합니다.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: 이 기간 동안에는 다른 어드밴티지 플랜으로 변경하거나 오리지널 메디케어로 돌아가는 변경을 1회 할 수 있지만, 독립형 약품 플랜에 가입하는 것은 허용되지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## 도움을 받을 수 있는 곳

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov**에서 플랜 검색 도구와 연례 "Medicare & You" 책자를 제공합니다.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)**를 통해 메디케어 상담원과 연결할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - **주 건강보험 지원 프로그램(SHIP)**은 모든 주에서 무료의 편향되지 않은 1대1 상담을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: 요청하지 않은 전화, 우편물, 광고에 주의하세요.

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: 메디케어는 플랜을 판매하기 위해 느닷없이 전화하지 않으며, 본인이 직접 연락하지 않은 상대에게는 절대로 메디케어 번호를 알려주어서는 안 됩니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어와 메디케어 어드밴티지 사이에서 보편적으로 더 우수한 선택이란 없습니다.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: 올바른 답은 귀하의 건강 요구사항, 선호하는 의사, 예산 및 원하는 예측 가능성의 정도에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: 12월 7일 이전에 플랜의 연례 변경 통지서를 검토하고, 옵션을 비교하며, 공식 출처를 통해 세부 사항을 확인함으로써 새해에 예상치 못한 상황을 방지할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not insurance, legal or medical advice.
segments.tr: *본 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 보험, 법률 또는 의료 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Plan details and costs vary by location and change annually; verify current information with Medicare or a licensed counselor.*
segments.tr: 플랜 세부 사항 및 비용은 지역에 따라 다르며 매년 변경되므로, 메디케어 또는 자격 있는 상담사를 통해 최신 정보를 확인하시기 바랍니다.*

zh.title: 红蓝卡公开 (Medicare) 注册期于 10 月 15 日开始：传统红蓝卡与红蓝卡优选计划对比

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: 每年秋天，数百万拥有红蓝卡 (Medicare) 的美国人都有机会重新审视一项影响他们接下来整整一年医疗保健和预算的决定。

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: 年度公开注册期为 **10 月 15 日至 12 月 7 日**，在此期间做出的任何更改将于 **1 月 1 日**生效。

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: 对于许多人来说，核心问题是继续使用传统红蓝卡 (Original Medicare) 还是选择红蓝卡优选计划 (Medicare Advantage)。

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: 没有哪种选择对每个人都是绝对正确的。

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: 以下是用通俗易懂的语言为您梳理在截止日期前需要比较的内容。

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## 公开注册期允许您做什么

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 在秋季注册窗口期间，红蓝卡受益人通常可以：

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - 从传统红蓝卡转为红蓝卡优选计划（C 部分，Part C）。

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - 从红蓝卡优选计划转回传统红蓝卡。

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - 从一个红蓝卡优选计划更换为另一个。

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - 加入、退订或更换独立的 D 部分 (Part D) 处方药计划。

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: 如果您对当前的保障已经满意，则无需采取任何行动。

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: 但计划的费用、医疗服务提供者网络、涵盖的药物和福利可能会逐年变化，因此即使您打算保持现状，快速浏览一下也是值得的。

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## 两种基本途径

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### 传统红蓝卡 (Original Medicare)

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: 传统红蓝卡由联邦政府运营，主要包含两部分：A 部分（住院保险）和 B 部分（医疗保险）。

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 主要特点包括：

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **广泛的医疗服务提供者选择。** 您通常可以去看全国任何接受红蓝卡的医生或去任何医院。

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **无需转诊**即可看大多数专科医生。

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **没有年度自付费用上限的分摊费用。** 您通常需要支付免赔额和费用分摊（通常为 B 部分承保服务的 20%），并且您可能承担的费用没有年度上限。

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **附加险是分开的。** 处方药保障（D 部分）和用于支付免赔额及共同保险的 Medigap 补充险需要单独购买，并有各自的保费。

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### 红蓝卡优选计划 (Medicare Advantage, Part C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡优选计划由经红蓝卡批准的私营保险公司提供。

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: 它们必须涵盖传统红蓝卡所涵盖的所有内容，并且大多数计划还捆绑了额外福利。

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 主要特点包括：

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **医疗服务网络。** 许多计划是 HMO 或 PPO，这意味着只有在使用网络内的医疗服务提供者时，您的费用可能会更低，或者保障才可能适用。

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **网络内支出的年度上限。** 与传统红蓝卡不同，优选计划必须为承保服务设定最高自付费用限额。

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **额外福利。** 许多计划包括处方药保障，并可能增加牙科、视力、听力或健身福利。

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **事先授权。** 某些服务可能需要在您接受护理前获得计划的批准。

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **低保费或 0 美元保费很常见，** 尽管您通常必须继续支付 B 部分保费。

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## 需要比较的五个方面

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. 您的医生和医院

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: 检查您信赖的医生、专科医生和医院是否在计划的网络内。

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: 网络可能会发生变化，因此请直接与您的医疗服务提供者和计划确认，而不是依赖去年的信息。

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. 总费用，而不仅仅是保费

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 较低的月保费并不能说明全部问题。

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 请查看免赔额、共付额、共同保险和自付费用上限。

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: 如果您有慢性病或预计要做手术，请估算在每种选择下高使用率的一年可能会花费多少。

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: 计划会维护一份涵盖药物的清单（称为处方集），并且这些清单可能会发生变化。

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: 在 Medicare.gov 的计划查找工具中输入您当前的药物以比较估计的年度费用，并确认您的药房在计划的网络内。

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: D 部分对药物自付费用也有每年调整的上限，请查看当前的具体数字。

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. 额外福利以及您将如何实际使用它们

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: 牙科、视力和听力福利很有价值，但它们通常带有年度金额限制或限制条件。

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: 询问涵盖哪些内容、有哪些上限，以及您将使用的医疗服务提供者是否参与其中。

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. 旅行和灵活性

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: 如果您有一段时间在另一个州度过或经常旅行，请检查计划如何处理其服务区域之外的护理。

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: 传统红蓝卡在全国范围内有效，而许多优选计划是围绕本地构建的。

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## 值得了解的时间问题

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: 转换并不总是对称的。

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: 如果您从红蓝卡优选计划转回传统红蓝卡并想要一份 Medigap 补充险，大多数州的保险公司被允许审查您的健康史，并可能会在某些受保护期之外收取更高的费用或拒绝向您出售保单。

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: 考虑离开优选计划的人在离开前应了解其所在州的规则。

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: 另请注意，如果您已经加入了红蓝卡优选计划，则在 1 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日期间有一个单独的红蓝卡优选计划公开注册期。

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: 它允许进行一次更改（更改为另一个优选计划或转回传统红蓝卡），但不允许您加入独立的药物计划。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## 在哪里获得帮助

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** 提供计划查找工具和年度《Medicare & You》手册。

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
- **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - **州健康保险援助计划 (SHIPs)** 在每个州提供免费、公正的一对一咨询。

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: 对未经邀请的电话、邮件和广告保持警惕。

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡不会无缘无故地打电话向您推销计划，您绝不应该将您的红蓝卡号透露给您未曾主动联系过的人。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: 在传统红蓝卡和红蓝卡优选计划之间，没有普遍更好的选择。

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: 正确的答案取决于您的健康需求、您首选的医生、您的预算以及您希望获得多少可预测性。

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: 在 12 月 7 日之前查阅计划的年度变更通知、比较选项并与官方来源确认详细信息，可以帮助您避免在新的一年中遇到意外。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not insurance, legal or medical advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不构成保险、法律或医疗建议。

segments.src: Plan details and costs vary by location and change annually; verify current information with Medicare or a licensed counselor.*
segments.tr: 计划详情和费用因地点而异且每年都在变化；请向红蓝卡官方或持牌顾问核实当前信息。*

hi.title: Medicare Open Enrollment Starts October 15: Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: हर शरद ऋतु में, Medicare वाले लाखों अमेरिकियों को एक ऐसे निर्णय पर पुनर्विचार करने का मौका मिलता है जो आने वाले पूरे वर्ष के लिए उनकी स्वास्थ्य देखभाल और उनके बजट को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: वार्षिक Open Enrollment Period **October 15 से December 7** तक चलती है, और उस अवधि के दौरान किए गए कोई भी बदलाव **January 1** से प्रभावी होते हैं।

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: कई लोगों के लिए, मुख्य प्रश्न यह है कि Original Medicare के साथ बने रहना है या Medicare Advantage योजना चुनना है।

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: कोई भी विकल्प हर किसी के लिए सही नहीं है।

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: यहाँ इस बात पर एक सरल अंग्रेजी नज़र डाली गई है कि समय सीमा से पहले क्या तुलना करनी चाहिए।

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: शरद ऋतु की अवधि के दौरान, Medicare वाले लोग आमतौर पर यह कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - Original Medicare से Medicare Advantage योजना (Part C) पर स्विच करें।

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - Medicare Advantage योजना से वापस Original Medicare पर स्विच करें।

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - एक Medicare Advantage योजना से दूसरी में बदलें।

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - स्टैंड-अलोन Part D प्रिस्क्रिप्शन ड्रग प्लान में शामिल हों, छोड़ें या बदलें।

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: यदि आप पहले से ही अपने कवरेज से संतुष्ट हैं, तो आपको कुछ करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: लेकिन योजनाएं साल-दर-साल अपनी लागत, प्रदाता नेटवर्क, कवर की गई दवाओं और लाभों को बदल सकती हैं, इसलिए यदि आप बने रहने की योजना बनाते हैं तब भी एक त्वरित समीक्षा सार्थक है।

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: जो लोग Advantage से दूर जाने पर विचार कर रहे हैं, उन्हें योजना छोड़ने से पहले अपने राज्य के नियमों को सीखना चाहिए।

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: यह भी ध्यान दें कि यदि आप पहले से ही Medicare Advantage योजना में हैं, तो January 1 से March 31 तक एक अलग Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period है।

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.

segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** आपको Medicare प्रतिनिधियों से जोड़ता है।

segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** प्रत्येक राज्य में मुफ्त, निष्पक्ष, आमने-सामने परामर्श प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: अपेक्षित कॉलों, मेलर्स और विज्ञापनों से सावधान रहें।

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.

es.title: Inscripción abierta de Medicare comienza el 15 de octubre: Medicare Original vs. Medicare Advantage

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: Cada otoño, millones de estadounidenses con Medicare tienen la oportunidad de reconsiderar una decisión que afecta su atención médica y sus presupuestos para todo el año siguiente.

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: El período anual de inscripción abierta se extiende desde el **15 de octubre hasta el 7 de diciembre**, y cualquier cambio realizado durante ese período entra en vigor el **1 de enero**.

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: Para muchas personas, la pregunta central es si deben permanecer en Medicare Original o elegir un plan de Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: Ninguna de las opciones es adecuada para todos.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Aquí hay una perspectiva en un lenguaje sencillo sobre lo que se debe comparar antes de la fecha límite.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## Lo que le permite hacer la inscripción abierta

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Durante el período de otoño, las personas con Medicare generalmente pueden:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - Cambiar de Medicare Original a un plan de Medicare Advantage (Parte C).

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - Cambiar de un plan de Medicare Advantage de regreso a Medicare Original.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - Cambiar de un plan de Medicare Advantage a otro.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - Inscribirse, cancelar o cambiar un plan independiente de medicamentos recetados de la Parte D.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: Si ya está satisfecho con su cobertura, no tiene que hacer nada.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: Pero los planes pueden cambiar sus costos, redes de proveedores, medicamentos cubiertos y beneficios de un año a otro, por lo que vale la pena una revisión rápida incluso si planea quedarse donde está.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## Las dos rutas básicas

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### Medicare Original

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: Medicare Original es administrado por el gobierno federal y tiene dos partes principales: la Parte A (seguro de hospital) y la Parte B (seguro médico).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Las características clave incluyen:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **Amplio acceso a proveedores.** Por lo general, puede ver a cualquier médico o visitar cualquier hospital del país que acepte Medicare.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **No se necesitan remisiones** para ver a la mayoría de los especialistas.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **Compartir costos sin un límite anual de gastos de bolsillo.** Por lo general, paga un deducible y una parte de los costos, a menudo el 20% de los servicios cubiertos por la Parte B, y no hay un límite anual sobre lo que podría deber.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Los complementos son independientes.** La cobertura de medicamentos recetados (Parte D) y las pólizas suplementarias de Medigap, que ayudan a pagar los deducibles y el coseguro, se compran por separado y tienen sus propias primas.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Parte C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Los planes de Medicare Advantage son ofrecidos por aseguradoras privadas aprobadas por Medicare.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Deben cubrir todo lo que cubre Medicare Original, y la mayoría incluye extras.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Las características clave incluyen:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Una red de proveedores.** Muchos planes son HMO o PPOs, lo que significa que sus costos pueden ser menores, o la cobertura puede aplicarse únicamente, cuando utiliza proveedores dentro de la red.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Un límite anual para los gastos dentro de la red.** A diferencia de Medicare Original, los planes Advantage deben establecer un límite máximo de gastos de bolsillo para los servicios cubiertos.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Extras.** Muchos planes incluyen cobertura de medicamentos recetados y pueden agregar beneficios dentales, de visión, audición o acondicionamiento físico.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Autorización previa.** Algunos servicios pueden requerir la aprobación del plan antes de recibir atención.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Las primas de planes bajas o de $0 son comunes,** aunque por lo general debe seguir pagando su prima de la Parte B.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## Cinco cosas que comparar

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. Sus médicos y hospitales

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: Verifique si los médicos, especialistas y hospitales en los que confía están en la red de un plan.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: Las redes pueden cambiar, así que confírmelo directamente con sus proveedores y con el plan en lugar de confiar en la información del año pasado.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. Costo total, no solo la prima

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Una prima mensual baja no cuenta toda la historia.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: Observe el deducible, los copagos, el coseguro y el máximo de gastos de bolsillo.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: Si tiene una afección crónica o espera una cirugía, estime cuánto podría costar un año de alto uso bajo cada opción.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. Medicamentos recetados

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: Los planes mantienen listas de medicamentos cubiertos, llamadas formularios, y estas pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Ingrese sus medicamentos actuales en la herramienta de búsqueda de planes en Medicare.gov para comparar los costos anuales estimados y confirme que su farmacia esté en la red del plan.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: La Parte D también tiene un límite anual en el gasto de bolsillo en medicamentos que se ajusta cada año, así que verifique la cifra actual.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Beneficios adicionales y cómo los usará realmente

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: Los beneficios dentales, de visión y audición pueden ser valiosos, pero a menudo vienen con límites de dólares anuales o restricciones.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: Pregunte qué está cubierto, qué tiene un límite y si los proveedores que usaría participan.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. Viajes y flexibilidad

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: Si pasa parte del año en otro estado o viaja con frecuencia, verifique cómo maneja un plan la atención fuera de su área de servicio.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: Medicare Original funciona en todo el país, mientras que muchos planes Advantage están diseñados en torno a una región local.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## Un problema de tiempo que vale la pena conocer

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: El cambio no siempre es simétrico.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: Si pasa de Medicare Advantage a Medicare Original y desea una póliza de Medigap, a las aseguradoras en la mayoría de los estados se les permite revisar su historial médico y pueden cobrar más o negarse a venderle una póliza fuera de ciertos períodos protegidos.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: Las personas que están considerando alejarse de Advantage deben conocer las reglas de su estado antes de abandonar un plan.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: También tenga en cuenta que si ya se encuentra en un plan de Medicare Advantage, hay un período de inscripción abierta de Medicare Advantage independiente del 1 de enero al 31 de marzo.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: Permite un cambio, ya sea a otro plan Advantage o de regreso a Medicare Original, pero no le permite unirse a un plan de medicamentos independiente.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Dónde obtener ayuda

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** ofrece una herramienta de búsqueda de planes y el manual anual "Medicare & You".

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.tr: No hay una opción universalmente mejor entre Medicare Original y Medicare Advantage.

segments.tr: بالنسبة للكثيرين، السؤال الأساسي هو ما إذا كان يجب البقاء في برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي (Original Medicare) أم اختيار خطة ميزة الرعاية الصحية (Medicare Advantage).

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: لا يوجد خيار مناسب للجميع.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: إليك نظرة بلغة مبسطة لما يجب مقارنته قبل الموعد النهائي.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## ما تتيحه لك فترة التسجيل المفتوح

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: خلال نافذة الخريف، يمكن للمشتركين في برنامج الرعاية الصحية عموماً:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - الانتقال من برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي إلى خطة ميزة الرعاية الصحية (الجزء C).

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - الانتقال من خطة ميزة الرعاية الصحية والعودة إلى برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - التغيير من خطة ميزة رعاية صحية إلى أخرى.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - الانضمام إلى خطة أدوية تُصرف بوصفة طبية مستقلة (الجزء D)، أو إلغاؤها، أو تغييرها.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: إذا كنت راضياً بالفعل عن تغطيتك، فلا داعي لفعال أي شيء.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: ولكن يمكن للخطط تغيير تكاليفها، وشبكات مقدمي الخدمات، والأدوية المغطاة، والمزايا من عام لآخر، لذا فإن إجراء مراجعة سريعة يستحق العناء حتى لو كنت تنوي البقاء في مكانك.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## المساران الأساسيان

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي (Original Medicare)

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: يتم إدارة برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي من قبل الحكومة الفيدرالية ويتكون من جزأين رئيسيين: الجزء A (التأمين للمستشفيات) والجزء B (التأمين الطبي).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: تشمل الميزات الرئيسية ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **إمكانية الوصول على نطاق واسع لمقدمي الخدمات.** يمكنك عموماً رؤية أي طبيب أو زيارة أي مستشفى في البلاد يوافق على برنامج الرعاية الصحية (Medicare).

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **لا توجد حاجة لإحالات** لرؤية معظم الأخصائيين.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **تقاسم التكاليف بدون حد أقصى سنوي لما تدفعه من جيبك.** عادةً ما تدفع مبلغاً مقطوعاً للخصم وحصة من التكاليف، غالباً ما تكون 20% للخدمات التي يغطيها الجزء B، وليس هناك حد أسنوي لما قد تدين به.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **الإضافات منفصلة.** يتم شراء تغطية الأدوية الموصوفة (الجزء D) وبوالص التأمين التكميلي Medigap، والتي تساعد في دفع مبالغ الخصم والتأمين المشترك، بشكل منفصل وتأتي مع أقساطها الخاصة.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### ميزة الرعاية الصحية (الجزء C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: يتم تقديم خطط ميزة الرعاية الصحية من قبل شركات تأمين خاصة معتمدة من قِبل برنامج الرعاية الصحية.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: يجب أن تغطي كل ما يغطيه برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي، وتتضمن معظمها مزايا إضافية.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: تشمل الميزات الرئيسية ما يلي:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **شبكة مقدمي الخدمات.** العديد من الخطط هي منظمات صيانة الصحة HMOs أو مؤسسات المزودين المفضلين PPOs، مما يعني أن تكاليفك قد تكون أقل، أو قد تسري التغطية فقط، عندما تستخدم مقدمي خدمات داخل الشبكة.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **حد أقصى سنوي للإنفاق داخل الشبكة.** على عكس برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي، يجب أن تضع خطط الميزة حداً أقصى للمبلغ الذي تدفعه من جيبك للخدمات المغطاة.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **المزايا الإضافية.** تتضمن العديد من الخطط تغطية للأدوية الموصوفة وقد تضيف مزايا خاصة بالأسنان، أو الرؤية، أو السمع، أو اللياقة البدنية.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **الموافقة المسبقة.** قد تتطلب بعض الخدمات موافقة الخطة قبل تلقي الرعاية.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **أقساط الخطة المنخفضة أو التي تبلغ قيمتها 0 دولار شائعة،** على الرغم من أنه يجب عليك عموماً الاستمرار في دفع قسط الجزء B الخاص بك.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## خمسة أمور يجب مقارنتها

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. أطباؤك ومستشفياتك

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: تحقق مما إذا كان الأطباء والأخصائيون والمستشفيات التي تعتمد عليها ضمن شبكة الخطة.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتغير الشبكات، لذا تأكد مباشرة من مقدمي الخدمات لديك ومن الخطة بدلاً من الاعتماد على معلومات العام الماضي.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. التكلفة الإجمالية، وليس القسط فقط

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: القسط الشهري المنخفض لا يروي القصة كاملة.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: انظر إلى مبلغ الخصم، والدفعات المشتركة، والتأمين المشترك، والحد الأقصى لما تدفعه من جيبك.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تعاني من حالة مزمنة أو تتوقع إجراء جراحة، فقدر ما قد تكلفه سنة الاستخدام الكثيف في ظل كل خيار.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. الأدوية الموصوفة

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: تحتفظ الخطط بقوائم للأدوية المغطاة، تسمى الصيغ، ويمكن أن تتغير هذه القوائم.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: أدخل أدويةك الحالية في أداة البحث عن الخطط على موقع Medicare.gov لمقارنة التكاليف السنوية المقدرة، وتأكد من أن صيدليتك ضمن شبكة الخطة.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: يحتوي الجزء D أيضاً على حد سنوي للإنفاق على الأدوية من جيبك والذي يتم تعديله كل عام، لذا تحقق من الرقم الحالي.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. المزايا الإضافية وكيف ستستخدمها فعلياً

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون مزايا الأسنان والرؤية والسمع ذات قيمة، ولكن غالباً ما تأتي بحدود مالية سنوية أو قيود.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: اسأل عما يتم تغطيته، وما هو محدد بسقف، وما إذا كان مقدمو الخدمات الذين ستستخدمهم مشاركين.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. السفر والمرونة

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تقضي جزءاً من العام في ولاية أخرى أو تسافر كثيراً، تحقق من كيفية تعامل الخطة مع الرعاية خارج نطاق خدمتها.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: يعمل برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي على مستوى الدولة، بينما يتم تصميم العديد من خطط الميزة حول منطقة محلية.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## مشكلة توقيت تجدر معرفتها

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: التبديل ليس متماثلاً دائماً.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: إذا انتقلت من ميزة الرعاية الصحية إلى برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي وتريد بوليصة Medigap، يُسمح لشركات التأمين في معظم الولايات بمراجعة تاريخك الصحي وقد تفرض رسوماً أكبر أو ترفض بيعك بوليصة خارج فترات محمية معينة.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: يجب على الأشخاص الذين يفكرون في الانتقال بعيداً عن خطط الميزة معرفة قواعد ولايتهم قبل مغادرة الخطة.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: لاحظ أيضاً أنه إذا كنت بالفعل في خطة ميزة الرعاية الصحية، فهناك فترة تسجيل مفتوح منفصلة لميزة الرعاية الصحية من 1 يناير إلى 31 مارس.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: وهي تسمح بتغيير واحد، إما إلى خطة ميزة أخرى أو العودة إلى برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي، ولكنها لا تسمح لك بالانضمام إلى خطة أدوية مستقلة.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## أين تحصل على المساعدة

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - يوفر موقع **Medicare.gov** أداة للبحث عن الخطط ودليل "Medicare & You" السنوي.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
segments.tr: - يربطك الرقم **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** بممثلي برنامج الرعاية الصحية.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - توفر **برامج المساعدة في التأمين الصحي للولاية (SHIPs)** استشارات مجانية وغير محازبة وفردية في كل ولاية.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: كن حذراً من المكالمات والرسائل الإعلانية والإعلانات غير الطلوبة.

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: لن يتصل بك برنامج الرعاية الصحية من فراغ لبيع خطة، ويجب عليك أبدأ عدم إعطاء رقم الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك لشخص لم تتصل به بنفسك.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: ليس هناك خيار أفضل عالمياً بين برنامج الرعاية الصحية الأصلي وميزة الرعاية الصحية.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: الإجابة الصحيحة تعتمد على احتياجاتك الصحية، والأطباء المفضلين لديك، وميزانيتك، ومقدار القدرة على التنبؤ التي تريدها.

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: مراجعة إشعار التغييرات السنوي لخضتك، ومقارنة الخيارات وتأكيد التفاصيل مع المصادر الرسمية قبل 7 ديسمبر يمكن أن يساعدك في تجنب المفاجآت في العام الجديد.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not insurance, legal or medical advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلوماتية عامة فقط وليست نصيحة تأمينية أو قانونية أو طبية.

segments.src: Plan details and costs vary by location and change annually; verify current information with Medicare or a licensed counselor.*
segments.tr: تختلف تفاصيل الخطة والتكاليف حسب الموقع وتتغير سنويًا؛ تحقق من المعلومات الحالية مع برنامج الرعاية الصحية أو مستشار مرخص.*

fr.title: Période d'inscription ouverte à Medicare à partir du 15 octobre : Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: Chaque automne, des millions d'Américains bénéficiant de Medicare ont la possibilité de réexaminer une décision qui affecte leurs soins de santé et leur budget pour toute l'année suivante.

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: La période annuelle d'inscription ouverte se déroule du **15 octobre au 7 décembre**, et tous les changements effectués au cours de cette période prennent effet le **1er janvier**.

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreuses personnes, la question centrale est de savoir s'il faut conserver l'Original Medicare ou choisir un plan Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: Aucune option n'est idéale pour tout le monde.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Voici un aperçu en termes simples de ce qu'il faut comparer avant la date limite.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que permet la période d'inscription ouverte

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Pendant la période d'automne, les bénéficiaires de Medicare peuvent généralement :

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - Passer de l'Original Medicare à un plan Medicare Advantage (Partie C).

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - Passer d'un plan Medicare Advantage à l'Original Medicare.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - Changer d'un plan Medicare Advantage à un autre.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - S'inscrire, résilier ou changer de plan de médicaments sur ordonnance de la Partie D.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes déjà satisfait de votre couverture, vous n'avez rien à faire.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: Mais les plans peuvent modifier leurs coûts, leurs réseaux de prestataires, les médicaments couverts et les avantages d'une année sur l'autre, de sorte qu'un examen rapide vaut la peine même si vous prévoyez de ne rien changer.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## Les deux voies fondamentales

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### Original Medicare

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: L'Original Medicare est géré par le gouvernement fédéral et comprend deux parties principales : la Partie A (assurance hospitalisation) et la Partie B (assurance médicale).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Les principales caractéristiques comprennent :

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **Large accès aux prestataires.** Vous pouvez généralement consulter n'importe quel médecin ou visiter n'importe quel hôpital du pays qui accepte Medicare.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **Aucune orientation nécessaire** pour consulter la plupart des spécialistes.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **Partage des coûts sans plafond annuel de dépenses personnelles.** Vous payez généralement une franchise et une part des coûts, souvent 20 % des services couverts par la Partie B, et il n'y a pas de limite annuelle sur ce que vous pourriez devoir.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Les suppléments sont distincts.** La couverture des médicaments sur ordonnance (Partie D) et les polices de complément Medigap, qui aident à payer les franchises et les coassurances, sont achetées séparément et ont leurs propres primes.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Partie C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Les plans Medicare Advantage sont proposés par des assureurs privés approuvés par Medicare.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Ils doivent couvrir tout ce que couvre l'Original Medicare, et la plupart intègrent des avantages supplémentaires.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Les principales caractéristiques comprennent :

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Un réseau de prestataires.** De nombreux plans sont des HMO ou des PPOs, ce qui signifie que vos coûts peuvent être inférieurs, ou que la couverture ne s'applique que lorsque vous utilisez des prestataires du réseau.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Un plafond annuel sur les dépenses de réseau.** Contrairement à l'Original Medicare, les plans Advantage doivent fixer une limite maximale de dépenses personnelles pour les services couverts.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Avantages supplémentaires.** De nombreux plans incluent une couverture des médicaments sur ordonnance et peuvent ajouter des avantages dentaires, de vision, auditifs ou de conditionnement physique.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Autorisation préalable.** Certains services peuvent nécessiter l'approbation du plan avant de recevoir des soins.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Des primes de plan faibles ou à 0 $ sont courantes,** bien que vous deviez généralement continuer à payer votre prime de la Partie B.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## Cinq éléments à comparer

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. Vos médecins et hôpitaux

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: Vérifiez si les médecins, spécialistes et hôpitaux sur lesquels vous comptez font partie du réseau d'un plan.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: Les réseaux peuvent changer, alors confirmez directement auprès de vos prestataires et du plan plutôt que de vous fier aux informations de l'année dernière.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. Le coût total, pas seulement la prime

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Une prime mensuelle basse ne dit pas tout.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: Examinez la franchise, les co-paiements, la coassurance et le maximum des dépenses personnelles.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: Si vous avez une affection chronique ou prévoyez une chirurgie, estimez ce qu'une année de forte utilisation pourrait coûter sous chaque option.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. Médicaments sur ordonnance

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: Les plans maintiennent des listes de médicaments couverts, appelées formulaires, et celles-ci peuvent changer.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Entrez vos médicaments actuels dans l'outil de recherche de plans sur Medicare.gov pour comparer les coûts annuels estimés, et confirmez que votre pharmacie est dans le réseau du plan.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: La Partie D a également une limite annuelle sur les dépenses de médicaments personnelles qui s'ajuste chaque année, alors vérifiez le chiffre actuel.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Avantages supplémentaires et comment vous les utiliserez réellement

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: Les avantages dentaires, de vision et auditifs peuvent être précieux, mais ils s'accompagnent souvent de limites de dollars annuelles ou de restrictions.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: Demandez ce qui est couvert, ce qui est plafonné et si les prestataires que vous utiliseriez participent.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. Voyage et flexibilité

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: Si vous passez une partie de l'année dans un autre État ou voyagez souvent, vérifiez comment un plan gère les soins en dehors de sa zone de service.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: L'Original Medicare fonctionne à l'échelle nationale, tandis que de nombreux plans Advantage sont construits autour d'une région locale.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## Un problème de timing qu'il vaut la peine de connaître

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: Le changement n'est pas toujours symétrique.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: Si vous passez de Medicare Advantage à l'Original Medicare et souhaitez une police Medigap, les assureurs de la plupart des États sont autorisés à examiner vos antécédents médicaux et peuvent facturer plus ou refuser de vous vendre une police en dehors de certaines périodes protégées.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: Les personnes qui envisagent de quitter Advantage devraient connaître les règles de leur État avant de quitter un plan.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Notez également que si vous êtes déjà dans un plan Medicare Advantage, il existe une période d'inscription ouverte Medicare Advantage distincte du 1er janvier au 31 mars.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: Elle permet un changement, soit vers un autre plan Advantage, soit vers l'Original Medicare, mais elle ne vous permet pas de rejoindre un plan de médicaments autonome.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Où obtenir de l'aide

segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** propose un outil de recherche de plans et le manuel annuel "Medicare & You".

segments.tr: - **Les State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** offrent des conseils gratuits, impartiaux et individuels dans chaque État.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: Méfiez-vous des appels, des envois postaux et des publicités non sollicités.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: Il n'y a pas de choix universellement meilleur entre l'Original Medicare et le Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: La bonne réponse dépend de vos besoins de santé, de vos médecins préférés, de votre budget et du degré de prévisibilité que vous souhaitez.

pt.title: O Período de Inscrição Aberta do Medicare começa em 15 de outubro: Medicare Original vs. Medicare Advantage

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: Todo outono, milhões de americanos com Medicare têm a chance de reavaliar uma decisão que afeta seus cuidados de saúde e seus orçamentos para todo o ano seguinte.

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: O Período de Inscrição Aberta anual ocorre de **15 de outubro a 7 de dezembro**, e quaisquer alterações feitas durante esse período entram em vigor em **1º de janeiro**.

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: Para muitas pessoas, a questão central é se devem permanecer com o Medicare Original ou escolher um plano Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: Nenhuma das opções é a certa para todos.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Aqui está uma análise em linguagem simples sobre o que comparar antes do prazo final.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## O que a Inscrição Aberta permite que você faça

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Durante o período de outono, as pessoas com Medicare geralmente podem:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - Mudar do Medicare Original para um plano Medicare Advantage (Parte C).

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - Mudar de um plano Medicare Advantage de volta para o Medicare Original.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - Mudar de um plano Medicare Advantage para outro.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - Entrar, sair ou mudar de um plano de medicamentos prescritos da Parte D independente.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: Se você já está satisfeito com sua cobertura, não precisa fazer nada.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: Mas os planos podem alterar seus custos, redes de provedores, medicamentos cobertos e benefícios de um ano para o outro, então uma revisão rápida vale a pena, mesmo que você planeje continuar como está.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## Os dois caminhos básicos

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### Medicare Original

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: O Medicare Original é administrado pelo governo federal e tem duas partes principais: Parte A (seguro hospitalar) e Parte B (seguro médico).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Os principais recursos incluem:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **Amplo acesso a provedores.** Você geralmente pode consultar qualquer médico ou visitar qualquer hospital no país que aceite Medicare.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **Não são necessários encaminhamentos** para consultar a maioria dos especialistas.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **Compartilhamento de custos sem um limite anual de despesas diretas.** Você normalmente paga uma franquia e uma parte dos custos, geralmente 20% dos serviços cobertos pela Parte B, e não há limite anual para o que você pode dever.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Complementos são separados.** A cobertura de medicamentos prescritos (Parte D) e as apólices suplementares Medigap, que ajudam a pagar franquias e cosseguro, são adquiridas separadamente e vêm com seus próprios prêmios.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Parte C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Os planos Medicare Advantage são oferecidos por seguradoras privadas aprovadas pelo Medicare.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Eles devem cobrir tudo o que o Medicare Original cobre, e a maioria inclui extras.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Os principais recursos incluem:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Uma rede de provedores.** Muitos planos são HMOs ou PPOs, o que significa que seus custos podem ser menores, ou a cobertura pode se aplicar apenas quando você usa provedores da rede.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Um limite anual de gastos na rede.** Ao contrário do Medicare Original, os planos Advantage devem definir um limite máximo de despesas diretas para serviços cobertos.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Extras.** Muitos planos incluem cobertura de medicamentos prescritos e podem adicionar benefícios odontológicos, oftalmológicos, auditivos ou de condicionamento físico.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Autorização prévia.** Alguns serviços podem exigir a aprovação do plano antes que você receba o atendimento.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Prêmios de plano baixos ou de $0 são comuns,** embora você geralmente deva continuar pagando seu prêmio da Parte B.

segments.tr: ### 3. Medicamentos prescritos

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.

segments.tr: ### 4. Benefícios extras e como você realmente os usará
