segments.tr: - **Pembagian biaya tanpa batas pengeluaran pribadi tahunan.** Anda biasanya membayar biaya deduktibel dan sebagian dari biaya, sering kali sebesar 20% untuk layanan yang dicakup Bagian B, dan tidak ada batasan tahunan atas jumlah yang mungkin harus Anda bayar.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Manfaat tambahan bersifat terpisah.** Cakupan obat resep (Bagian D) dan polis tambahan Medigap, yang membantu membayar deduktibel dan koasuransi, dibeli secara terpisah dan memiliki premi tersendiri.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Bagian C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Rencana Medicare Advantage ditawarkan oleh perusahaan asuransi swasta yang disetujui oleh Medicare.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Rencana ini harus mencakup semua hal yang dicakup oleh Original Medicare, dan sebagian besar menyertakan manfaat tambahan.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Fitur utamanya meliputi:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Jaringan penyedia layanan.** Banyak rencana berupa HMO atau PPO, yang berarti biaya Anda mungkin lebih rendah, atau cakupan hanya berlaku, saat Anda menggunakan penyedia layanan dalam jaringan.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Batasan tahunan untuk pengeluaran dalam jaringan.** Tidak seperti Original Medicare, rencana Advantage harus menetapkan batas maksimum pengeluaran pribadi untuk layanan yang dicakup.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Manfaat tambahan.** Banyak rencana mencakup cakupan obat resep dan dapat menambahkan manfaat gigi, penglihatan, pendengaran, atau kebugaran.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Persetujuan awal.** Beberapa layanan mungkin memerlukan persetujuan dari pihak rencana sebelum Anda menerima perawatan.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Premi rencana yang murah atau $0 sangat umum,** meskipun Anda umumnya tetap harus membayar premi Bagian B Anda.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## Lima Hal yang Perlu Dibandingkan

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. Dokter dan rumah sakit Anda

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: Periksa apakah dokter, spesialis, and rumah sakit yang Anda andalkan masuk dalam jaringan suatu rencana.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: Jaringan dapat berubah, jadi konfirmasikan langsung dengan penyedia layanan Anda dan pihak rencana alih-alih mengandalkan informasi tahun lalu.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. Total biaya, bukan hanya preminya

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Premi bulanan yang rendah tidak mencerminkan keseluruhan situasi biaya.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: Perhatikan deduktibel, copayment, koasuransi, dan batas pengeluaran pribadi.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memiliki kondisi kronis atau memperkirakan akan menjalani operasi, perkirakan berapa biaya yang mungkin dikeluarkan dalam tahun dengan penggunaan tinggi di bawah masing-masing pilihan.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. Obat resep

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: Rencana memelihara daftar obat yang dicakup, yang disebut formularium, dan daftar ini dapat berubah.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Masukkan obat-obatan Anda saat ini ke dalam alat pencari rencana di Medicare.gov untuk membandingkan perkiraan biaya tahunan, dan konfirmasikan bahwa apotek Anda berada dalam jaringan rencana tersebut.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: Bagian D juga memiliki batas tahunan untuk pengeluaran obat pribadi yang disesuaikan setiap tahun, jadi periksa angka saat ini.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Manfaat tambahan dan bagaimana Anda akan menggunakannya

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: Manfaat gigi, penglihatan, dan pendengaran bisa sangat berharga, tetapi sering kali disertai dengan batasan dolar tahunan atau ketentuan tertentu.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: Tanyakan apa saja yang dicakup, apa saja batasan biayanya, dan apakah penyedia layanan yang akan Anda gunakan ikut berpartisipasi.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. Perjalanan dan fleksibilitas

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menghabiskan sebagian tahun di negara bagian lain atau sering bepergian, periksa bagaimana suatu rencana menangani perawatan di luar wilayah layanannya.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: Original Medicare berlaku di seluruh negeri, sementara banyak rencana Advantage dibuat berdasarkan wilayah lokal.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## Masalah Waktu yang Perlu Diketahui

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: Melakukan perpindahan tidak selalu bersifat simetris.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: Jika Anda beralih dari Medicare Advantage kembali ke Original Medicare dan menginginkan polis Medigap, perusahaan asuransi di sebagian besar negara bagian diizinkan untuk meninjau riwayat kesehatan Anda dan dapat mengenakan biaya lebih tinggi atau menolak menjual polis kepada Anda di luar periode perlindungan tertentu.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: Orang yang mempertimbangkan untuk meninggalkan Advantage sebaiknya mempelajari aturan negara bagian mereka sebelum keluar dari suatu rencana.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Perhatikan juga bahwa jika Anda sudah berada dalam rencana Medicare Advantage, terdapat Periode Pendaftaran Terbuka Medicare Advantage yang terpisah dari 1 Januari hingga 31 Maret.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: Periode ini mengizinkan satu kali perubahan, baik ke rencana Advantage lain atau kembali ke Original Medicare, tetapi tidak mengizinkan Anda untuk bergabung dengan rencana obat yang berdiri sendiri.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Tempat Mendapatkan Bantuan

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** menawarkan alat pencari rencana dan buku panduan tahunan "Medicare & You".

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** menghubungkan Anda dengan perwakilan Medicare.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** menyediakan konseling gratis, independen, dan tatap muka di setiap negara bagian.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: Berhati-hatilah terhadap panggilan, surat, dan iklan yang tidak diminta.

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Medicare tidak akan menelepon Anda secara tiba-tiba untuk menjual rencana, dan Anda tidak boleh memberikan nomor Medicare Anda kepada seseorang yang tidak Anda hubungi sendiri.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: Tidak ada pilihan yang secara universal lebih baik antara Original Medicare dan Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: Jawaban yang tepat bergantung pada kebutuhan kesehatan Anda, dokter pilihan Anda, anggaran Anda, dan seberapa besar prediktabilitas yang Anda inginkan.

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: Meninjau pemberitahuan perubahan tahunan rencana Anda, membandingkan opsi, dan mengonfirmasi detail dengan sumber resmi sebelum 7 Desember dapat membantu Anda menghindari kejutan di tahun baru.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat asuransi, hukum, atau medis.

segments.src: Plan details and costs vary by location and change annually; verify current information with Medicare or a licensed counselor.*
segments.tr: Detail dan biaya rencana bervariasi menurut lokasi dan berubah setiap tahun; verifikasi informasi terkini dengan Medicare atau konselor berlisensi.*

ja.title: メディケア公開登録期間は10月15日に開始：オリジナル・メディケア対メディケア・アドバンテージ

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: 毎年秋になると、メディケアを利用する何百万人ものアメリカ人が、翌年全体の医療ケアと予算に影響を与える決定を再検討する機会を得ます。

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: 年次の公開登録期間は**10月15日から12月7日**までであり、その期間内に行われた変更は**1月1日**に発効します。

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: 多くの人にとって、中心的な疑問はオリジナル・メディケアにとどまるべきか、それともメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランを選択すべきかという点です。

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: どちらの選択肢もすべての人にとって正しいわけではありません。

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: 期限前に何を比較すべきかについて、わかりやすい英語で解説します。

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## 公開登録でできること

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 秋の期間中、メディケア受給者は一般的に次のことができます：

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - オリジナル・メディケアからメディケア・アドバンテージ・プラン（パートC）への切り替え。

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランからオリジナル・メディケアへの切り戻し。

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - あるメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランから別のプランへの変更。

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - 単独のパートD処方薬プランへの加入、脱退、または変更。

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: 現在の保障内容にすでに満足している場合は、何もする必要はありません。

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: しかし、プランは年によって費用、プロバイダー・ネットワーク、対象となる医薬品、特典を変更することがあるため、そのまま継続する予定であっても、簡単な見直しを行う価値があります。

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## 2つの基本的な道

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### オリジナル・メディケア

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: オリジナル・メディケアは連邦政府によって運営されており、パートA（病院保険）とパートB（医療保険）の2つの主要な部分から構成されています。

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 主な特徴は以下の通りです：

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **幅広いプロバイダーへのアクセス。** 一般的に、メディケアを受け入れている国内のどの医師の診察も、どの病院の利用も可能です。

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - ほとんどの専門医を受診する際に**紹介状は不要**です。

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **年間自己負担上限額のないコストシェアリング。** 通常、免責金額と費用の一部（パートB対象サービスの多くは20%）を支払い、支払う可能性のある金額に年間上限はありません。

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **アドオンは別料金です。** 免責金額や自己負担額の支払いを助ける処方薬カバー（パートD）およびメディギャップ補助保険は個別に購入され、それぞれの保険料がかかります。

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### メディケア・アドバンテージ（パートC）

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランは、メディケアによって承認された民間保険会社によって提供されています。

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: これらはオリジナル・メディケアがカバーするすべてのものをカバーしなければならず、ほとんどが追加特典をバンドルしています。

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: 主な特徴は以下の通りです：

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **プロバイダー・ネットワーク。** 多くのプランはHMOまたはPPOであり、これはネットワーク内のプロバイダーを利用する場合にのみ費用が安くなったり、保障が適用されたりすることを意味します。

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **ネットワーク内支出の年間上限。** オリジナル・メディケアとは異なり、アドバンテージ・プランは対象サービスに対する最大自己負担限度額を設定する必要があります。

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **追加特典。** 多くのプランには処方薬の保障が含まれており、歯科、視力、聴力、またはフィットネスの特典が追加される場合があります。

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **事前承認。** 一部のサービスでは、ケアを受ける前にプランの承認が必要となる場合があります。

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **低額または0ドルのプラン保険料が一般的ですが、** 通常はパートBの保険料を支払い続ける必要があります。

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## 比較すべき5つの事項

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. 医師と病院

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: 頼りにしている医師、専門医、病院がプランのネットワークに含まれているか確認してください。

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: ネットワークは変更される可能性があるため、昨年の情報に頼るのではなく、プロバイダーとプランに直接確認してください。

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. 保険料だけでなく総費用

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 月々の保険料が安いだけでは全容はわかりません。

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: 免責金額、自己負担額、コインシュアランス、および自己負担上限額を確認してください。

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: 持病がある場合や手術が予想される場合は、利用頻度が高い年に各オプションでいくらかかるかを見積もってください。

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: プランは処方薬リスト（フォーミュラリーと呼ばれる）を維持しており、これらは変更される可能性があります。

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Medicare.govのプラン検索ツールに現在の薬を入力して、推定年間費用を比較し、薬局がプランのネットワーク内にあることを確認してください。

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: パートDにも、毎年調整される処方薬の自己負担額に対する年間制限があるため、現在の数値を確認してください。

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. 追加特典と実際の利用方法

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: 歯科、視力、聴力の特典は価値がありますが、多くの場合、年間の金額制限や制限が伴います。

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: 何がカバーされ、何に上限があり、利用するプロバイダーが参加しているかどうかを尋ねてください。

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. 旅行と柔軟性

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: 一年の半分を別の州で過ごしたり、頻繁に旅行したりする場合は、プランがサービスエリア外のケアをどのように処理するかを確認してください。

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: オリジナル・メディケアは全国で機能しますが、多くのアドバンテージ・プランは地域圏を中心に構築されています。

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## 知っておくべきタイミングの問題

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: 切り替えは必ずしも対称的ではありません。

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージからオリジナル・メディケアに戻り、メディギャップ方針を希望する場合、ほとんどの州の保険会社は健康履歴を確認することが許可されており、特定の保護期間外にポリシーの販売価格を引き上げたり、販売を拒否したりする場合があります。

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: アドバンテージからの移行を検討している人は、プランを離れる前に自州の規則を学ぶべきです。

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: また、すでにメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランに加入している場合は、1月1日から3月31日まで別のメディケア・アドバンテージ公開登録期間があることにも注意してください。

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: これにより、別の優遇プランへの変更か、オリジナル・メディケアへの変更のいずれか1つの変更が許可されますが、単独の薬プランへの加入は許可されません。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## ヘルプの取得先

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** はプラン検索ツールと年次「Medicare & You」ハンドブックを提供しています。

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line

de.title: Die offene Einschreibungsphase für Medicare beginnt am 15. Oktober: Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans with Medicare get a chance to revisit a decision that affects their health care and their budgets for the entire following year.
segments.tr: Jeden Herbst haben Millionen von Amerikanern mit Medicare die Möglichkeit, eine Entscheidung zu überdenken, die ihre Gesundheitsversorgung und ihre Budgets für das gesamte folgende Jahr beeinflusst.

segments.src: The annual Open Enrollment Period runs from **October 15 to December 7**, and any changes made during that window take effect on **January 1**.
segments.tr: Der jährliche Einschreibungszeitraum läuft vom **15. Oktober bis zum 7. Dezember**, und alle in diesem Zeitfenster vorgenommenen Änderungen treten am **1. Januar** in Kraft.

segments.src: For many people, the central question is whether to stay with Original Medicare or choose a Medicare Advantage plan.
segments.tr: Für viele Menschen lautet die zentrale Frage, ob sie bei Original Medicare bleiben oder einen Medicare Advantage-Tarif wählen sollen.

segments.src: Neither option is right for everyone.
segments.tr: Keine Option ist für jeden die richtige.

segments.src: Here is a plain-English look at what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Hier ist ein leicht verständlicher Blick darauf, was vor Ablauf der Frist verglichen werden sollte.

segments.src: ## What Open Enrollment Lets You Do
segments.tr: ## Was Sie während des Einschreibungszeitraums tun können

segments.src: During the fall window, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Während des Herbstfensters können Personen mit Medicare im Allgemeinen:

segments.src: - Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C).
segments.tr: - Von Original Medicare zu einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif (Part C) wechseln.

segments.src: - Switch from a Medicare Advantage plan back to Original Medicare.
segments.tr: - Von einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif zurück zu Original Medicare wechseln.

segments.src: - Change from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.
segments.tr: - Von einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif zu einem anderen wechseln.

segments.src: - Join, drop or change a stand-alone Part D prescription drug plan.
segments.tr: - Einen eigenständigen Part D-Verschreibungspflichtmedikamententarif abschließen, abwählen oder wechseln.

segments.src: If you are already satisfied with your coverage, you do not have to do anything.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie mit Ihrem Versicherungsschutz bereits zufrieden sind, müssen Sie nichts tun.

segments.src: But plans can change their costs, provider networks, covered drugs and benefits from year to year, so a quick review is worthwhile even if you plan to stay put.
segments.tr: Tarife können jedoch von Jahr zu Jahr ihre Kosten, Anbieter-Netzwerke, abgedeckten Medikamente und Leistungen ändern, sodass eine kurze Überprüfung auch dann sinnvoll ist, wenn Sie bleiben möchten.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths
segments.tr: ## Die zwei grundlegenden Wege

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### Original Medicare

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: Original Medicare wird von der Bundesregierung verwaltet und hat zwei Hauptteile: Part A (Krankenhausversicherung) und Part B (Krankenversicherung).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Zu den Hauptmerkmalen gehören:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **Breiter Zugang zu Anbietern.** Sie können im Allgemeinen jeden Arzt aufsuchen oder jedes Krankenhaus im Land besuchen, das Medicare akzeptiert.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **Keine Überweisungen erforderlich**, um die meisten Fachärzte aufzusuchen.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **Kostenteilung ohne jährliche Obergrenze für Eigenleistungen.** Sie zahlen typischerweise eine Selbstbeteiligung und einen Kostenanteil, oft 20% der durch Part B abgedeckten Leistungen, und es gibt kein jährliches Limit für das, was Sie schulden könnten.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Zusatzleistungen sind separat.** Die Absicherung von verschreibungspflichtigen Medikamenten (Part D) und Medigap-Zusatzversicherungen, die bei der Bezahlung von Selbstbeteiligungen und Mitversicherungen helfen, werden separat erworben und haben eigene Prämien.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Medicare Advantage-Tarife werden von privaten Versicherern angeboten, die von Medicare zugelassen sind.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Sie müssen alles abdecken, was Original Medicare abdeckt, und die meisten bündeln Extras darin.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Zu den Hauptmerkmalen gehören:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Ein Anbieter-Netzwerk.** Viele Tarife sind HMOs oder PPOs, was bedeutet, dass Ihre Kosten niedriger sein können oder der Versicherungsschutz nur dann gilt, wenn Sie netzwerkinterne Anbieter nutzen.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Eine jährliche Obergrenze für netzwerkinterne Ausgaben.** Im Gegensatz zu Original Medicare müssen Advantage-Tarife ein maximales Eigenlimit für abgedeckte Leistungen festlegen.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Extras.** Viele Tarife beinhalten eine Absicherung für verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente und können Zahn-, Seh-, Hör- oder Fitnessleistungen hinzufügen.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Vorherige Genehmigung.** Einige Leistungen erfordern möglicherweise die Genehmigung des Tarifs, bevor Sie Pflege erhalten.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Niedrige oder 0-$ Tarifprämien sind üblich,** obwohl Sie im Allgemeinen Ihre Part B-Prämie weiter zahlen müssen.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## Fünf Dinge zum Vergleichen

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. Ihre Ärzte und Krankenhäuser

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie, ob die Ärzte, Fachärzte und Krankenhäuser, auf die Sie sich verlassen, im Netzwerk eines Tarifs sind.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: Netzwerke können sich ändern. Bestätigen Sie dies daher direkt bei Ihren Leistungserbringern und dem Plan, anstatt sich auf die Informationen des Vorjahres zu verlassen.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. Die Gesamtkosten, nicht nur die Prämie

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Eine niedrige monatliche Prämie sagt nicht alles aus.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: Betrachten Sie die Selbstbeteiligung, Zuzahlungen, den Mitversicherungsteil und die Belastungsobergrenze (Out-of-Pocket Maximum).

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie an einer chronischen Erkrankung leiden oder eine Operation erwarten, schätzen Sie ab, was ein Jahr mit hoher Inanspruchnahme bei den einzelnen Optionen kosten könnte.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. Verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: Pläne führen Listen abgedeckter Medikamente, die als Formularies bezeichnet werden, und diese können sich ändern.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Geben Sie Ihre aktuellen Medikamente in das Plan-Finder-Tool auf Medicare.gov ein, um die geschätzten jährlichen Kosten zu vergleichen, und vergewissern Sie sich, dass sich Ihre Apotheke im Netzwerk des Plans befindet.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: Part D hat zudem eine jährliche Obergrenze für die eigenen Arzneimittelausgaben, die sich jährlich anpasst. Überprüfen Sie daher den aktuellen Wert.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Zusätzliche Leistungen und wie Sie diese tatsächlich nutzen

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: Zahn-, Seh- und Hörleistungen können wertvoll sein, sind jedoch oft mit jährlichen Dollar-Limits oder Einschränkungen verbunden.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: Fragen Sie nach, was abgedeckt ist, wo Obergrenzen gelten und ob die von Ihnen genutzten Leistungserbringer teilnehmen.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. Reisen und Flexibilität

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie einen Teil des Jahres in einem anderen Bundesstaat verbringen oder häufig reisen, prüfen Sie, wie ein Plan mit der Versorgung außerhalb seines Servicegebiets umgeht.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: Original Medicare gilt bundesweit, während viele Advantage-Pläne auf eine lokale Region ausgerichtet sind.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## Ein zeitlicher Aspekt, den man kennen sollte

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: Ein Wechsel ist nicht immer symmetrisch.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie von Medicare Advantage zu Original Medicare zurückkehren und eine Medigap-Police wünschen, dürfen Versicherer in den meisten Bundesstaaten Ihre Gesundheitshistorie überprüfen und verlangen möglicherweise mehr Geld oder lehnen es ab, Ihnen außerhalb bestimmter geschützter Zeiträume eine Police zu verkaufen.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: Personen, die einen Wechsel weg von Advantage in Betracht ziehen, sollten die Regeln ihres Bundesstaates kennen, bevor sie einen Plan verlassen.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Beachten Sie außerdem, dass es für den Fall, dass Sie sich bereits in einem Medicare Advantage-Plan befinden, eine separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period vom 1. Januar bis zum 31. März gibt.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: Diese erlaubt eine Änderung, entweder zu einem anderen Advantage-Plan oder zurück zu Original Medicare, berechtigt Sie jedoch nicht zum Beitritt zu einem eigenständigen Medikamentenplan.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Wo Sie Hilfe erhalten

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** bietet ein Plan-Finder-Tool und das jährliche Handbuch „Medicare & You“ an.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** verbindet Sie mit Medicare-Vertretern.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** bieten in jedem Bundesstaat eine kostenlose, unvoreingenommene Einzelberatung an.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: Seien Sie vorsichtig bei unaufgeforderten Anrufen, Werbesendungen und Anzeigen.

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Medicare wird Sie nicht überraschend anrufen, um einen Plan zu verkaufen, und Sie sollten Ihre Medicare-Nummer niemals an jemanden weitergeben, den Sie nicht selbst kontaktiert haben.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: Es gibt keine universell bessere Wahl zwischen Original Medicare und Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: Die richtige Antwort hängt von Ihren gesundheitlichen Bedürfnissen, Ihren bevorzugten Ärzten, Ihrem Budget und der gewünschten Vorhersehbarkeit ab.

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: Die Überprüfung der jährlichen Änderungsmitteilung Ihres Plans, der Vergleich von Optionen und das Bestätigen von Details bei offiziellen Quellen vor dem 7. Dezember können Ihnen helfen, Überraschungen im neuen Jahr zu vermeiden.

segments.src: ## The Two Basic Paths

segments.src: ### Original Medicare
segments.tr: ### Medicare Gốc

segments.src: Original Medicare is run by the federal government and has two main parts: Part A (hospital insurance) and Part B (medical insurance).
segments.tr: Medicare Gốc được điều hành bởi chính phủ liên bang và có hai phần chính: Phần A (bảo hiểm bệnh viện) và Phần B (bảo hiểm y tế).

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Các tính năng chính bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Broad provider access.** You can generally see any doctor or visit any hospital in the country that accepts Medicare.
segments.tr: - **Quyền tiếp cận nhà cung cấp rộng rãi.** Bạn thường có thể gặp bất kỳ bác sĩ nào hoặc đến bất kỳ bệnh viện nào trong nước chấp nhận Medicare.

segments.src: - **No referrals needed** to see most specialists.
segments.tr: - **Không cần giấy giới thiệu** để gặp hầu hết các bác sĩ chuyên khoa.

segments.src: - **Cost sharing without a yearly out-of-pocket cap.** You typically pay a deductible and a share of costs, often 20% of Part B-covered services, and there is no annual limit on what you could owe.
segments.tr: - **Chia sẻ chi phí không có giới hạn tự chi trả hàng năm.** Bạn thường trả một khoản khấu trừ và một phần chi phí, thường là 20% các dịch vụ được Phần B chi trả, và không có giới hạn hàng năm về số tiền bạn có thể phải trả.

segments.src: - **Add-ons are separate.** Prescription drug coverage (Part D) and Medigap supplemental policies, which help pay deductibles and coinsurance, are purchased separately and come with their own premiums.
segments.tr: - **Các phần bổ trợ là riêng biệt.** Phạm vi bảo hiểm thuốc theo toa (Phần D) và các chính sách bổ sung Medigap, giúp thanh toán các khoản khấu trừ và đồng bảo hiểm, được mua riêng và đi kèm với phí bảo hiểm riêng của chúng.

segments.src: ### Medicare Advantage (Part C)
segments.tr: ### Medicare Advantage (Phần C)

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans are offered by private insurers approved by Medicare.
segments.tr: Các chương trình Medicare Advantage được cung cấp bởi các công ty bảo hiểm tư nhân được Medicare phê duyệt.

segments.src: They must cover everything Original Medicare covers, and most bundle in extras.
segments.tr: Chúng phải chi trả mọi thứ mà Medicare Gốc chi trả và hầu hết đều tích hợp các quyền lợi bổ sung.

segments.src: Key features include:
segments.tr: Các tính năng chính bao gồm:

segments.src: - **A provider network.** Many plans are HMOs or PPOs, which means your costs may be lower, or coverage may apply only, when you use in-network providers.
segments.tr: - **Mạng lưới nhà cung cấp.** Nhiều chương trình là HMO hoặc PPO, có nghĩa là chi phí của bạn có thể thấp hơn hoặc phạm vi bảo hiểm chỉ có hiệu lực khi bạn sử dụng các nhà cung cấp trong mạng lưới.

segments.src: - **A yearly cap on in-network spending.** Unlike Original Medicare, Advantage plans must set a maximum out-of-pocket limit for covered services.
segments.tr: - **Giới hạn hàng năm đối với chi tiêu trong mạng lưới.** Không giống như Medicare Gốc, các chương trình Advantage phải đặt ra giới hạn tối đa tự chi trả cho các dịch vụ được chi trả.

segments.src: - **Extras.** Many plans include prescription drug coverage and may add dental, vision, hearing or fitness benefits.
segments.tr: - **Quyền lợi bổ sung.** Nhiều chương trình bao gồm bảo hiểm thuốc theo toa và có thể bổ sung các quyền lợi nha khoa, thị giác, thính giác hoặc thể dục.

segments.src: - **Prior authorization.** Some services may require the plan's approval before you receive care.
segments.tr: - **Sự chấp thuận trước.** Một số dịch vụ có thể yêu cầu sự chấp thuận của chương trình trước khi bạn nhận được dịch vụ chăm sóc.

segments.src: - **Low or $0 plan premiums are common,** though you generally must keep paying your Part B premium.
segments.tr: - **Phí bảo hiểm chương trình thấp hoặc 0 đô la là phổ biến,** mặc dù bạn thường phải tiếp tục trả phí bảo hiểm Phần B của mình.

segments.src: ## Five Things to Compare
segments.tr: ## Năm Điều Cần So Sánh

segments.src: ### 1. Your doctors and hospitals
segments.tr: ### 1. Bác sĩ và bệnh viện của bạn

segments.src: Check whether the physicians, specialists and hospitals you rely on are in a plan's network.
segments.tr: Kiểm tra xem các bác sĩ, chuyên gia và bệnh viện mà bạn tin tưởng có nằm trong mạng lưới của chương trình hay không.

segments.src: Networks can change, so confirm directly with your providers and with the plan rather than relying on last year's information.
segments.tr: Mạng lưới có thể thay đổi, vì vậy hãy xác nhận trực tiếp với các nhà cung cấp của bạn và với chương trình thay vì dựa vào thông tin của năm ngoái.

segments.src: ### 2. Total cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 2. Tổng chi phí, không chỉ phí bảo hiểm

segments.src: A low monthly premium does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng thấp không nói lên toàn bộ câu chuyện.

segments.src: Look at the deductible, copayments, coinsurance and the out-of-pocket maximum.
segments.tr: Hãy xem xét khoản khấu trừ, đồng chi trả, đồng bảo hiểm và mức tối đa tự chi trả.

segments.src: If you have a chronic condition or expect surgery, estimate what a high-use year might cost under each option.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn có một tình trạng bệnh lý mãn tính hoặc dự kiến phẫu thuật, hãy ước tính chi phí cho một năm sử dụng nhiều theo từng lựa chọn.

segments.src: ### 3. Prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 3. Thuốc theo toa

segments.src: Plans maintain lists of covered drugs, called formularies, and these can change.
segments.tr: Các chương trình duy trì danh sách các loại thuốc được chi trả, gọi là danh mục thuốc và những danh mục này có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: Enter your current medications into the plan finder tool on Medicare.gov to compare estimated annual costs, and confirm that your pharmacy is in the plan's network.
segments.tr: Nhập các loại thuốc hiện tại của bạn vào công cụ tìm kiếm chương trình trên Medicare.gov để so sánh chi phí hàng năm ước tính và xác nhận rằng hiệu thuốc của bạn nằm trong mạng lưới của chương trình.

segments.src: Part D also has an annual limit on out-of-pocket drug spending that adjusts each year, so check the current figure.
segments.tr: Phần D cũng có giới hạn hàng năm đối với chi tiêu thuốc tự chi trả được điều chỉnh hàng năm, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra số liệu hiện tại.

segments.src: ### 4. Extra benefits and how you will actually use them
segments.tr: ### 4. Quyền lợi bổ sung và cách bạn sẽ thực sự sử dụng chúng

segments.src: Dental, vision and hearing benefits can be valuable, but they often come with annual dollar limits or restrictions.
segments.tr: Quyền lợi nha khoa, thị giác và thính giác có thể có giá trị, nhưng chúng thường đi kèm với giới hạn bằng tiền hàng năm hoặc các hạn chế.

segments.src: Ask what is covered, what is capped, and whether the providers you would use participate.
segments.tr: Hãy hỏi những gì được chi trả, những gì bị giới hạn và liệu các nhà cung cấp bạn định sử dụng có tham gia hay không.

segments.src: ### 5. Travel and flexibility
segments.tr: ### 5. Du lịch và tính linh hoạt

segments.src: If you spend part of the year in another state or travel often, check how a plan handles care outside its service area.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn dành một phần thời gian trong năm ở tiểu bang khác hoặc đi du lịch thường xuyên, hãy kiểm tra cách chương trình xử lý việc chăm sóc bên ngoài khu vực dịch vụ của chương trình đó.

segments.src: Original Medicare works nationwide, while many Advantage plans are built around a local region.
segments.tr: Medicare Gốc hoạt động trên toàn quốc, trong khi nhiều chương trình Advantage được xây dựng xung quanh một khu vực địa phương.

segments.src: ## A Timing Issue Worth Knowing About
segments.tr: ## Vấn đề Thời gian Đáng Biết

segments.src: Switching is not always symmetrical.
segments.tr: Việc chuyển đổi không phải lúc nào cũng đối xứng.

segments.src: If you move from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare and want a Medigap policy, insurers in most states are allowed to review your health history and may charge more or decline to sell you a policy outside of certain protected periods.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn chuyển từ Medicare Advantage quay lại Medicare Gốc và muốn có chính sách Medigap, các công ty bảo hiểm ở hầu hết các tiểu bang được phép xem xét lịch sử sức khỏe của bạn và có thể tính phí cao hơn hoặc từ chối bán chính sách cho bạn ngoài các khoảng thời gian được bảo vệ nhất định.

segments.src: People who are considering a move away from Advantage should learn their state's rules before they leave a plan.
segments.tr: Những người đang cân nhắc chuyển khỏi Advantage nên tìm hiểu các quy tắc của tiểu bang mình trước khi rời khỏi một chương trình.

segments.src: Also note that if you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Cũng lưu ý rằng nếu bạn đã tham gia chương trình Medicare Advantage, có một Thời gian Mở đăng ký Medicare Advantage riêng biệt từ ngày 1 tháng 1 đến ngày 31 tháng 3.

segments.src: It allows one change, either to another Advantage plan or back to Original Medicare, but it does not permit you to join a stand-alone drug plan.
segments.tr: Thời gian này cho phép thay đổi một lần, sang chương trình Advantage khác hoặc quay lại Medicare Gốc, nhưng không cho phép bạn tham gia một chương trình thuốc độc lập.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Help
segments.tr: ## Nơi Nhận Trợ Giúp

segments.src: - **Medicare.gov** offers a plan finder tool and the annual "Medicare & You" handbook.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov** cung cấp công cụ tìm kiếm chương trình và sổ tay "Medicare & You" hàng năm.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare representatives.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** kết nối bạn với các đại diện của Medicare.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs)** provide free, unbiased, one-on-one counseling in every state.
segments.tr: - **Các Chương trình Hỗ trợ Bảo hiểm Y tế Tiểu bang (SHIPs)** cung cấp dịch vụ tư vấn trực tiếp, miễn phí, khách quan ở mọi tiểu bang.

segments.src: Be cautious with unsolicited calls, mailers and ads.
segments.tr: Hãy thận trọng với các cuộc gọi, thư gửi và quảng cáo không mời mà tới.

segments.src: Medicare will not call you out of the blue to sell a plan, and you should never give out your Medicare number to someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Medicare sẽ không gọi cho bạn bất ngờ để bán một chương trình và bạn không bao giờ nên cung cấp số Medicare của mình cho người mà bạn không tự liên hệ.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: There is no universally better choice between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
segments.tr: Không có lựa chọn nào tốt hơn phổ quát giữa Medicare Gốc và Medicare Advantage.

segments.src: The right answer depends on your health needs, your preferred doctors, your budget and how much predictability you want.
segments.tr: Câu trả lời đúng phụ thuộc vào nhu cầu sức khỏe, các bác sĩ ưa thích, ngân sách của bạn và mức độ dự đoán mà bạn muốn.

segments.src: Reviewing your plan's annual notice of changes, comparing options and confirming details with official sources before December 7 can help you avoid surprises in the new year.
segments.tr: Việc xem xét thông báo thay đổi hàng năm của chương trình, so sánh các lựa chọn và xác nhận chi tiết với các nguồn chính thức trước ngày 7 tháng 12 có thể giúp bạn tránh những bất ngờ trong năm mới.
